itens.trecho: Visualmente grandioso e cheio de acção barulhenta, mas é só isso. Construir uma franquia inteira em cima do sucesso estrondoso de dois filmes foi um erro, e a comparação entre Exterminador Implacável 2 e este filme é até injusta.

Wall-to-wall post-apocalyptic action needed more time to breathe The first couple of Terminator films are easily two of the greatest sci-fi/action flicks in history. The problem with the third one, more than anything else, was that it was largely just more of the same; and you can only recycle the same plot so many times before it gets stale.

So... this was awful. It was just kind of pointless, but at least (unlike the new ones that seem to want to destroy the Terminator franchise) it fit into the series. So, you know, it COULD have been worse. At least Salvation seems like a continuation of the Terminator movies. That's about the best thing that could be said about it.
